QuestInfo.0: Now that #b#p1012100##k's calmed down, ask her about what's happened in the last few centuries and tell her about the Elves.
QuestInfo.1: #p1012100# tells you about the world: Rumors of the Black Mage's resurrection, his servants the Black Wings, the Cygnus Knights, the return of Aran without his memories... But right now, #p1012100# just wants to go to #b#m101050000##k...
QuestInfo.2: As soon as you stepped outside, you were attacked by a young boy wearing a robe. #p1012100# told you he's a Black Wing henchman and that he was eavesdropping on the conversation.

1.0: Are you okay, Your Majesty?\r\n#L0##bI'm fine. He just caught me off guard. How about you?#l\n#k
1.1: I'm all right. Thank goodness...\r\n#L0##bBut who are they? And why did they talk to us?#l\n#k
1.2: Did you see that wing symbol they were wearing?

yes.0: They call themselves the #rBlack Wings#k, but he was just a minion. They're trying to resurrect the Black Mage.

default.0: Hold on, I almost forgot... Please wait outside a moment, Your Highness.
